text:
sara: Quick heads-up — smoke deploy for mosaic-6b-v2 failed during serve readiness. Error mentions tokenizer/embedding size mismatch and then a weight path issue. @liam can you take a quick look?

ci-bot: [smoke-run] exit=1 — relevant tail:
```
RuntimeError: tokenizer.vocab_size (50260) != model.embedding.num_embeddings (50264)
Failed to open weights file: gs://redwood-models/mosaic-6b/v2/weights.pt (No such object)
```

liam: on it. two fast checks: 1) is weight_uri a prefix (ends with "/") vs full object? our loader needs exact file. 2) tokenizer vocab vs embedding mismatch usually means special tokens were added/removed between tokenizer files and model config.

sara: config snippet from the package we pushed:
```
{
  "model_family": "mosaic-6b",
  "weight_uri": "gs://redwood-models/mosaic-6b/v2/",
  "serve": { "max_seq_len": 2048 },
  "tokenizer": { "type": "bpe", "vocab_size": 50260, "special_tokens": ["", "<pad>"] }
}
```
derrick: that weight_uri is definitely a prefix. CI used to accept prefixes but a recent loader change requires file-level URIs. I'll add a quick shim in the config linter that errors on trailing slash.

liam: ok that explains weights fail. For the vocab mismatch: can someone dump the model config (embedding.num_embeddings) from the checkpoint? quick python snippet:
```
from torch import load
ckpt = load('weights.pt', map_location='cpu')
print(ckpt['model']['embeddings']['weight'].shape)
```
If it prints [50264, 1536] then tokenizer is short by 4 tokens.

sara: i pulled the checkpoint locally (downloaded with gsutil cp gs://redwood-models/mosaic-6b/v2/weights.pt .) Output from the snippet: "torch.Size([50264, 1536])"

rachel: that + config shows tokenizer.vocab_size 50260 -> missing 4 tokens. Common causes: (a) merges/tokenizer files differ between repo and artifact, (b) special_tokens were not merged into vocab during tokenizer export.

derrick: quick mitigation plan:
- add linter rule: weight_uri must resolve to an object (no trailing slash) and validator should try a HEAD on GCS (or fail-open for local tests)
- add schema check: tokenizer.vocab_size must equal embedding.num_embeddings OR a clear mapping field present (tokenizer.offset or embedding.offset)
- add a CI smoke that runs a small tokenizer.encode/embedding-size check during onboard PRs

liam: +1. impl detail: instead of failing hard for mismatch, the validator can emit WARNING with a link to an onboarding doc and an opt-in "allow-offset" flag. But for prod serving we want a hard error unless the team explicitly declares "embedding_offset": N.

sara: for this model i can regenerate tokenizer artifacts to include the missing 4 special tokens and push a fixed package to gs://redwood-models/mosaic-6b/v2/weights-ep1.pt and tokenizer files. Will do now and ping when done.

ci-bot: started background job: gcs copy in progress (job id 9876).

rachel: also note: when we changed the config.json schema last quarter we added optional field "embedding_base_index" for some legacy models. We should surface that in the onboard checklist so teams don't forget.

derrick: i'll open a tiny PR updating the schema and add a lint rule. will tag @sara for the model package change and @liam for validator logic.

sara: thanks. once i upload fixed artifacts can someone run the flame-smoke job? i'd rather not wait for full rollout.

liam: yep — once you confirm upload i'll trigger smoke and report back here. please include the new tokenizer files path in the PR description so the linter can cross-check. :thumbsup:

sara: uploaded weights-ep1.pt and tokenizer files to gs://redwood-models/mosaic-6b/v2/fixed/ — new weight_uri in package points to the exact object. confirming now.

ci-bot: [smoke-run] queued by liam (job 9881).

liam: smoke passed (fast serve + small eval) — embedding size matches tokenizer. closing this thread after i land derrick's PR and sara's package gets the final tag.

derrick: PR  #4023 opened: "schema: embedding size verification + weight_uri exact object lint". assigning reviewers @liam @rachel.

sara: awesome, thanks everyone. thats the short path to prod for this model.
